pieces.name: main_ns
pieces.notes: main body, ridge N-S (house frame) at u 192, LiDAR z 28-29 from v 125 to 195; big lit east face, south hip end with hips to both bottom corners.

pieces.name: north_hip
pieces.notes: narrower block continuing north of the main body (the main steps in at the NE), own N-S ridge at u 155 (LiDAR z 27), hips from the NW corner; chimney at its NE corner excluded.

pieces.name: west_wing
pieces.notes: west wing, ridge E-W at v 165 (LiDAR z 27), hips to both west corners, valley into the north block at u 115-160; porch band along its south edge excluded.

exclude_notes: brick patio and porch along the SW edge
notes: Single-level cross plan: N-S main hip, a narrower north hip, and an E-W west wing, all at the same eave. Confidence HIGH (all LiDAR faces z 22-25, lines agree with the visible hips). Frame: rotate 10.7 deg CW about (575,507), crop 300x320.
